data.name: Nafiis
data.gender_notes: Nafiis is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nafa'a' which means 'to support' or 'to succeed'. In Islamic history, the name Nafiis is given to those who have the qualities of a supporter and a successor. The name Nafiis carries the meaning “Successor, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafiis usually hope their child will grow to embody successor, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages acts of kindness and generosity
data.etymology: Nafiis belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successor, supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafiis total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: نفيس
in_arabic.meaning: النفيس يعني الثمين والغالي والجميل جدا
in_arabic.long_meaning: النفيس من الأسماء التي تعبر عن قيمة ورفعة، مشتقة من الجذر ن-ف-س الذي يدل على النفس والثمن، ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: ﴿وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا﴾، النفيس يعني الشخص الذي يمتلك قيمة روحية عالية، ويتميز بالجمال الداخلي والخارجي.

in_urdu.name: نفیث
in_urdu.meaning: نفیث کا مطلب ہے قیمتی، نفیس، اور خوبصورت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نفیث ایک ایسا نام ہے جو کسی چیز کی قیمتی ہونے کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اس کا عربی मूल ن-ف-س ہے جو 'نفس' کے معنی میں ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر ہندوستان اور پاکستان میں، جہاں یہ اسلامی ثقافت اور روایات کا حصہ ہے.

in_hindi.name: नफ़ीस

in_hindi.long_meaning: नफ़ीस एक ऐसा नाम है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है 'कीमती' या 'मूल्यवान', भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बच्चे की विशेषता और उसके उच्च गुणों को दर्शाने के लिए चुना जाता है.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nafiis carries the cultural significance of strength, support, and stability. In many Islamic communities, individuals with this name are seen as pillars of their families, communities, or even societies due to their resilient and sturdy nature. They are expected to provide support and stability to those around them and are often looked up to as leaders and advisors.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Nafiis is suggestive of the belief in the importance of being a support system for one another. Muslims believe in the interconnectedness of all creation and the role of living in communion with each other. Those named Nafiis are encouraged to embody the qualities of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said, "None of you will believe until you love for your brother what you love for yourself." The name Nafiis is seen as a reminder of the Quranic verse, "And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided" (3:103). By fulfilling this spiritual meaning of supporting and succeeding in their relationships with others, Muslims believe that they can attain closeness to Allah and a fulfilling life.
